note: Nothing the app does or shows changes, apart from the version number. The Launch button now flies through one shared path, which can also open a design file and fly it with no browser, and the .ork, RockSim and RASAero readers can parse their XML outside a browser, held to answers recorded from Chrome. Both are groundwork for a possible server (API) version of the app, which is being discussed and is not decided. On 25 Launch cases, each flight's summary and events and the run the button builds, keys included, are identical to v0.148's.
